metadata.description: Phase-aware AI coding (prototype, production, maintenance, ...) and resumable work: journal, per-branch handoff, backlog, /start and /finish.

plugins.name: project-phase
plugins.description: Makes the agent work the way the project's lifecycle phase needs: no over-engineering while prototyping, structural suggestions and tech-debt tracking in production, minimal regression-safe diffs in maintenance.

plugins.name: work-journal
plugins.description: Keeps a terse work journal and a per-branch handoff in the repo so any agent, model or human can pause and resume with zero context. Includes /backlog (task files, GitHub or GitLab issues, Jira), /start and /finish for branch work.
